title: Senior Software Engineering Lead - Java FSE
description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

  

A highly experienced Full Stack Engineer with 10\+ years of expertise in Java/J2EE, Spring Boot, Kafka, and Cloud Platforms (GCP/Azure), responsible for designing, developing, and supporting scalable, high\-performance enterprise applications.

 **Primary Responsibilities:**

* Design, develop, and maintain enterprise\-grade applications using Java/J2EE, Spring Boot, and microservices architecture
* Build and optimize event\-driven and real\-time data processing solutions using Apache Kafka, ensuring scalability, reliability, and fault tolerance
* Lead architecture discussions and contribute to technical design, solutioning, and technology roadmaps
* Develop secure, reusable, and high\-quality code following industry best practices, coding standards, and design patterns
* Implement and manage cloud\-native solutions on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and/or Microsoft Azure, leveraging services for compute, storage, networking, and monitoring
* Collaborate with product owners, business stakeholders, architects, and cross\-functional teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions
* Drive application modernization initiatives, including migration from monolithic systems to microservices and cloud platforms
* Ensure application reliability through performance tuning, monitoring, troubleshooting, and production support activities
* Implement CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure automation, and DevOps best practices to accelerate software delivery
* Mentor junior engineers, conduct code reviews, and promote engineering excellence across development teams
* Ensure adherence to security, compliance, and operational standards while delivering resilient and scalable solutions
* Participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies and contribute to planning, estimation, and successful project execution
* Comply with all applicable Company policies, procedures, and business directives, changes including those relating to work location, team assignments, work schedules, and flexible work arrangements

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field
* 10\+ years of hands\-on experience in software design, development, and support of enterprise applications
* Solid expertise in Java/J2EE, including Core Java, Multithreading, Collections, JVM tuning, and design patterns
* Extensive experience developing microservices\-based applications using Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Security, and RESTful APIs
* Proven experience implementing event\-driven architectures using Apache Kafka, including producers, consumers, Kafka Streams, topic management, and performance tuning
* Hands\-on experience with cloud platforms such as Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and/or Microsoft Azure, including deployment, monitoring, and cloud\-native services
* Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes  

Hands\-on experience with CI/CD tools and DevOps practices using Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps, or similar platforms
* Experience in Agile/Scrum development methodologies and working within cross\-functional teams
* Solid knowledge of relational and NoSQL databases such as Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, or BigQuery
* Solid understanding of distributed systems, scalability, resilience, security, and performance optimization
* Proven excellent analytical, problem\-solving, and troubleshooting skills
* Solid verbal and written communication skills with the ability to interact with technical and business stakeholders
* Skills \& Competencies:
	+ Solid expertise in Java/J2EE, Spring Boot, REST APIs, Microservices, and Kafka
	+ Hands\-on experience with GCP and/or Azure cloud services
	+ Experience with CI/CD, containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), and DevOps practices
	+ Solid understanding of distributed systems, cloud architecture, and event\-driven design
	+ Proven excellent problem\-solving, leadership, stakeholder management, and communication skills
* Leadership Expectations:
	+ Ability to lead technical discussions, architecture reviews, and design decisions
	+ Experience mentoring engineers, conducting code reviews, and driving engineering best practices
	+ Proven ability to manage multiple priorities while delivering high\-quality, scalable, and reliable solutions
	+ Solid collaboration and stakeholder management skills in a fast\-paced enterprise environment.

 **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Relevant cloud certifications such as Google Professional Cloud Architect, Google Professional Cloud Developer, Microsoft Azure Developer Associate, or Azure Solutions Architect Expert.
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Cloud Deployment Manager, ARM Templates, or Bicep)
* Experience in cloud migration, modernization, and application transformation initiatives
* Experience with API gateways, service mesh technologies, and event streaming platforms
* Knowledge of observability and monitoring tools such as Splunk, Dynatrace, Grafana, Prometheus, or Cloud Monitoring
* Exposure to AI/ML\-enabled products, data engineering pipelines, or large\-scale analytics platforms

 *At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone \- of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income \- deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. title: ITSO / Consultant Specialist
description:
Some careers shine brighter than others.


If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.


HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.


We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Consultant Specialist


In this role, you will:

* Own end\-to\-end service accountability for designated Cloud Applications (production and pre\-production), covering availability, performance, resiliency, security, and lifecycle management
* Act as the primary point of contact for the service across Technology, including stakeholder management with Product, Engineering, Cloud Platform, Cyber Security, Operations, and Vendors
* Define and maintain service standards and artefacts (service definition, service boundaries, SLO/SLAs, RTO/RPO, support model, runbooks, on\-call arrangements)
* Drive service reliability outcomes, incident reduction, problem management, and continuous improvement plans
* Lead operational governance: change/release readiness, capacity planning, maintenance windows, and operational risk management for cloud workloads
* Ensure effective monitoring and observability (metrics, logs, traces) and that alerting is actionable, prioritized, and linked to runbooks
* Own incident management for the service: major incident leadership/support, communications, coordination of restoration, post\-incident reviews, and remediation tracking
* Manage service resilience and DR: test planning/execution, failover readiness, backup/restore validation, and alignment to business continuity requirements
* Ensure compliance with relevant controls and evidence requirements (e.g., access controls, patching, vulnerability remediation, configuration baselines), partnering with control owners as needed


To be successful in this role, you should meet the following requirements:

* Proven experience as an IT Service Owner / Service Manager / Operations Lead for customer\-facing or business\-critical applications, preferably hosted on public cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP)
* Strong understanding of cloud application architecture and operations: networking basics, IAM, encryption, secrets management, containers/Kubernetes (where relevant), and managed services
* Hands\-on experience with IT service management practices (incident, problem, change, release, capacity, availability) and using service management tooling (e.g., ServiceNow or equivalent)
* Solid grasp of SRE/operational excellence concepts: SLOs/SLIs, monitoring/observability, reliability engineering, and automation\-first operations
* Experience coordinating major incidents under pressure, producing clear stakeholder communications, and driving root cause analysis to closure
* Working knowledge of resilience and DR in cloud: multi\-AZ/region patterns, backup strategies, DR testing, and recovery time objectives
* Excellent collaboration and influencing skills across multi\-disciplinary teams, with confidence to challenge constructively and “get it done” through others
* Good to have Cloud related certification.


You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.


www.hsbc.com/careers


HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

As a hands\-on technical leader for one or more Scrum teams, you will serve as a key voice in our architecture, driving innovation and ensuring our engineering practices meet the highest standards of quality and efficiency. This role is ideal for a "player\-coach" who thrives on influencing system design, mentoring engineers, and contributing directly to the codebase.


**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* **Technical Oversight:** Utilize in\-depth knowledge and skills across multiple Application Development domains to provide technical oversight of systems and applications.
* **Solution Architecture:** Review and analyze proposed technical solutions across ongoing and upcoming projects.
* **Strategic Contribution:** Contribute to the formulation of technical and architectural strategies for Application Development and related functional areas.

* **Standards \& Governance:** Ensure essential procedures and governance policies are followed, contribute to defining engineering standards, and negotiate with external parties when necessary.
* **Innovation \& Tooling:** Actively explore and integrate modern AI\-powered development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, advanced code analyzers) to accelerate delivery velocity, elevate code quality, and foster a culture of engineering innovation.

------------------------------


* **Experience:** 12\+ years of hands on experience in software design and development, with deep expertise in **Java technologies.** Proven track record in developing and optimizing multithreaded, high\-throughput applications.

* **Frontend Knowledge:** Familiarity with modern frontend frameworks (e.g., React, Angular) is a significant plus.

* Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent university degree/experience) in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field

title: Senior System Administrator
description:
We are looking for a Senior System Administrator to manage and maintain our IT infrastructure, systems, networks, security, domains, DNS, SSL certificates, and end\-user support. The ideal candidate should have strong troubleshooting skills and hands\-on experience in system and network administration.


The candidate will be responsible for ensuring the availability, security, performance, and reliability of IT systems while providing timely technical support to employees.  

  



###### **System Administration**


###### **Windows/Linux administration**

###### **Domain and DNS management**

###### **SSL/TLS certificates**

###### **Active Directory / Microsoft Entra ID**

#### **Responsibilities**


* Manage and troubleshoot hardware, software, operating system, and network\-related issues.
* Provide technical support to employees and resolve IT tickets within defined SLAs.
* Install, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot desktops, laptops, printers, servers, and other IT equipment.
* Monitor and maintain servers, networks, routers, switches, firewalls, and other infrastructure.
* Manage company domains, including purchase, renewal, registration, and ownership details.
* Configure and maintain DNS records such as A, CNAME, MX, and TXT records.
* Manage SSL/TLS certificates, including procurement, installation, renewal, and troubleshooting.
* Monitor system and network performance and perform regular health checks.
* Maintain IT security systems, including antivirus, endpoint protection, firewalls, access controls, and backups.
* Manage user accounts, permissions, system access, and security configurations.
* Maintain accurate records of IT assets, hardware, software, licenses, and configurations.
* Coordinate with IT vendors, domain registrars, hosting providers, and service providers.
* Perform regular backups and support data recovery and disaster recovery activities.
* Prepare and maintain IT documentation, SOPs, troubleshooting guides, and system configurations.
* Investigate recurring or major incidents and perform root\-cause analysis.
* Participate in system upgrades, migrations, infrastructure improvements, and IT projects.
* Identify opportunities to improve IT processes, security, and infrastructure efficiency.
* Provide technical guidance and basic IT security awareness training to employees.
#### **Must Have**


* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* 3 \- 5 years of relevant experience in System Administration / IT Infrastructure.
* Strong knowledge of Windows/Linux administration.
* Good understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPN, LAN/WAN, routing, and network troubleshooting.
* Hands\-on experience with domain and DNS management.
* Experience managing SSL/TLS certificates.
* Good knowledge of firewalls, antivirus, endpoint security, and access management.
* Strong hardware and software troubleshooting skills.
* Experience with IT asset and vendor management.
* Good problem\-solving and analytical skills.
* Strong communication and documentation skills.
#### **Nice to have**


* Experience with Active Directory / Microsoft Entra ID.
* Knowledge of Microsoft 365 or Google Workspace administration.
* Experience with AWS, Azure, or other cloud platforms.
* Knowledge of VMware / Hyper\-V.
* Experience with backup and disaster recovery solutions.
* IT certifications such as CCNA, CompTIA, Microsoft, AWS, Azure, or ITIL.
**What's great in the job?**
----------------------------

  

  

* Take ownership of critical IT infrastructure and keep systems secure, reliable, and high\-performing.
* Work across servers, networks, cloud platforms, security, DNS, domains, and enterprise IT systems.
* Solve challenging technical issues and drive root\-cause analysis rather than just addressing symptoms.
* Be part of infrastructure upgrades, migrations, and projects that directly improve business efficiency.
* Work with modern IT security, backup, disaster recovery, and endpoint management practices.
* Get the opportunity to continuously improve IT processes while working closely with teams, management, and technology partners.

title: KYC Operations Analyst
description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------


Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.


**Job Overview**
----------------


### **Job Description**


### **The KYC Operations Analyst 1 is an entry\-level position responsible for participating in Anti\-Money Laundering (AML) monitoring, governance, oversight and regulatory reporting activities in coordination with the Compliance and Control team. The overall objective of this role is to assist in the development and management of a dedicated internal KYC (Know Your Client) program at Citi.**

**Key Responsibilities:**

* ### **Create the KYC Record in the KYC system sourcing information from internal and external sources by the agreed deadline**
* ### **Proactively interact with relationship management teams and compliance to update system with information until final approval of KYC Record**
* ### **Review information from internal and external sources for company news (Firm website, Regulatory websites, Company website, Dun \& Bradstreet, Google etc.)**
* ### **Validate the information within the KYC Record and CIP document to ensure completeness and accurate (Company/Entity Formation documents, Ownership, Management, etc.)**
* ### **Complete KYC Record incorporating local regulatory requirements / Global BSU Standards and policies**
* ### **Take responsibility for KYC Record and associated documentation completion from initiation to approval**
* ### **Maintain BSU tool current and be able to demonstrate work carried out**
* ### **Report workflow progress to supervisor**
* ### **Ensure KYC workflow tool is kept up to date, ensuring all mandatory fields, status and commentary reflect an accurate representation of the status at all times**
* ### **Meet agreed daily targets for KYC Record review and completion within agreed Service Level Agreement timeframes**
* ### **Update workflow database regularly throughout the day**
* ### **Highlight any discrepancies to Senior Case Managers, Control Team and Section Managers**
* ### **Escalate any negative news and high\-risk cases to RM/PAM/AML Compliance department**
* ### **Assist in departmental projects as required**

### **Communication / Reporting**


* ### **Manage upward communication – Huddle updates, escalations, issues/ concerns etc.**
* ### **Track and report time log (CMs and Case Researcher) daily**
* ### **Monitor operational metrics required for management level reporting**

### **Knowledge/Experience:**

* ### **1 – 3 years’ experience in banking, finance, or law**
* ### **Experience in control/risk or Compliance (AML/KYC) function (an advantage)**
* ### **Knowledge of European Union regulatory KYC/AML requirements**
* ### **Flexible enough to work as per Business timings.**
* ### **Previous relevant experience preferred**

### **Education:**


* ### **Bachelor's degree/University degree or equivalent experience**
* ### **ACAMS certified (an advantage**

### **Skills:**

* ### **Demonstrated understanding of core AI concepts, including machine learning, and generative AI, and their potential impact on the business.**
* ### **The ability to identify and articulate opportunities for leveraging AI technologies to solve business problems and improve processes.**
* ### **Strong Negotiations skills**
* ### **Excellent written and verbal communication skills.**
* ### **Customer Services orientated**
* ### **Ability to develop strong professional relationships**
* ### **Strong research skills**
* ### **Accuracy and strong attention to detail**
* ### **Ability to work well under pressure and tight time frames**
* ### **Pro\-active, flexible, have good organizational skills and must be team player.**
* ### **Ability to work in a dynamic environment.**

title: Assistant Manager, Agentic Search
description:
**COMPANY OVERVIEW**

We exist to make food the world loves. But we do more than that. Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. We look for people who want to bring their best — bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one another and grow together. Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what’s next.

  

**OVERVIEW**  

The “Insights and Analytics” organization within General Mills’ Strategy and Growth function is responsible to deliver integrated consumer, customer, category, and business performance insights to power smarter, faster decisions and next\-best actions, enabling precision in brand strategies, campaign execution, media and investment optimization across our US businesses and brands. The Insights and Analytics org has integrated teams operating from our Minneapolis and India offices. This is a newly created agentic AI role within our HQ Marketing Operations – Digital Transformation org, and will be based in our India office.  



As the Agentic Search \- Assistant Manager, you will be a key part of General Mills’ Marketing Activation and Operations team, helping translate real\-time data signals into prioritized actions that improve the visibility, accuracy and representation of our brands in leading AI systems. This role will sit at the intersection of data and insight generation, with a focus on interpreting regular outputs from LLM (large language model) optimization partners and converting those outputs into clear, actionable recommendations for the broader AEO (answer engine optimization) team. You will regularly receive and analyze data from third\-party vendors, identify what the results mean for content, help inform optimization decisions, map the phasing of recommended actions, and coordinate implementation with cross\-functional partners. In addition, you will be directly responsible for hiring, mentoring, and coaching another Agentic AI Analyst, who will be reporting to you. As a thought leader, you will be building cross\-functional relationships, and working across marketing, content, and operations teams to bring in key insights that are actionable and help us show up in the agentic results.


This role is ideal for a highly curious, detail\-oriented analyst who enjoys working through complex datasets, finding the story in the data, and helping teams move from insight to action.


Based in the General Mills India Center (GIC), this role will operate as part of General Mills’ global model, with day\-to\-day work direction and priorities closely connected to U.S.\-based functional partners and managers.  

  



**KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES**

  

* **Data Analysis \& Performance Diagnostics:** Analyze large, nuanced datasets from LLM optimization platforms to diagnose what is working, what is not, and where search visibility can be improved.
* **Market \& Competitor Trend Tracking:** Maintain a proactive external view of relevant digital topics, retailer landscapes, and competitor movements to surface emerging generative search trends for internal teams.
* **Strategic Planning \& Prioritization:** Translate complex, rapidly evolving AI engine outputs into prioritized, phased optimization plans that focus resources on the highest\-value business opportunities.
* **Cross\-Functional Implementation:** Coordinate closely with cross\-functional partners to support the accurate, timely execution of approved optimization initiatives.
* **Stakeholder Reporting \& Capability Building:** Track optimization outcomes, maintain organized reporting, and surface risks and follow\-up opportunities to stakeholders while documenting learnings to refine the team's analytical approach over time.
* **Global Operating Model Support:** Enable a consistent, scalable way of working between U.S.\- and India\-based teams through proactive communication, strong organization, and clear documentation.
* **Pillar Leadership:** Build a high performing Agentic Analysis team in GIC, as an extension on the US Marketing Operations – Digital Transformation team. This involves both building the team, being responsible for deliverables – learning, context and acumen, and building capabilities/tools that may be required for the pillar.
* **Influence and Stakeholder Management:** Effectively communicate and provide leadership in meetings, influence decision making by proactively reaching out to stakeholders, ensuring timelines are met, meetings are productive and priorities are met timely.
* Mentor and coach the associate in India on best practices and remove roadblocks if any, with support from your manager
* Facilitate collaboration, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement within the larger Agentic Search team
Stay current on industry trends and consumer behavior insights, applying knowledge to refine and inform AI search optimization strategies.  
* 

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Digital Marketing, Computer Science, IT, Data Analytics, or a related field, with an MBA in Marketing / International Business.
* 4–6 years of experience in SEO, organic search, content optimization or digital marketing, with 2\+ years in AI Marketing Agents, AI Search Optimization, AEO, GEO or LLM\-based search.
* Strong understanding of technical SEO, semantic/entity optimization, structured data, content strategy and AI\-powered search platforms.
* Familiarity with ChatGPT, Gemini/Google AI Overviews, Claude, Perplexity and concepts such as LLMs, RAG and AI citations.
* Strong analytical, communication, project management and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Ability to generate actionable insights to optimize brand strategy execution.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and data interpretation skills.
Proficient in the use of Microsoft Excel, Navigating Tableau dashboards, R/SQL a plus  
* 

  

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Experience with tools such as Google Search Console, GA4, Semrush/Ahrefs and Screaming Frog.
* Strong understanding of search relevance, ranking, personalization, and evaluation metrics.
* Data\-driven approach to experimentation, performance monitoring, and continuous improvement.
* Ability to translate business needs into scalable search solutions and product roadmaps.
* Strong stakeholder management, communication, and cross\-functional leadership skills.

  

**ELIGIBILITY**

Applicants must meet minimum age qualifications in the country in which the job is located.

title: Gen AI Validator, Officer (Hybrid)
description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------


Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.


**Job Overview**
----------------


Citi is looking for an AI Risk Validator specialising in Generative AI to join its AI Review and Challenge Group within the Model Risk Management organisation — a team at the centre of how one of the world's largest financial institutions governs and validates AI. In this role, you will independently assess and challenge AI and machine learning systems across business lines, markets, and functions, spanning Generative AI, Agentic AI, natural language processing, computer vision, recommender systems, and anomaly detection. Your work directly shapes the integrity and governance of AI across Citi's global operations.


**Responsibilities**

* Prepare and contribute to responses for internal and external regulatory examinations, ensuring findings are well\-evidenced and clearly articulated.
* Contribute to the design and continuous improvement of risk frameworks, programmes, and practices that govern AI systems at scale.
* Collaborate on cross\-functional strategic initiatives within the model risk management organisation, helping to advance standards and best practices across the AI validation function.

**Required qualifications \& skills**


* Master's degree or above in mathematics, statistics, computer science, engineering, data science, AI, machine learning, or a related quantitative field.
* 4 or more years of analytics experience in financial services or a related industry, with at least 2 years focused on Generative AI, Agentic AI, or machine learning.
* Hands\-on technical knowledge of common AI and machine learning techniques, with the ability to critically assess their application and limitations in a financial context.
* Experience working in financial services, with a clear understanding of the risk, regulatory, and governance landscape relevant to AI systems.
* Ability to communicate complex technical findings clearly and concisely, both in writing and verbally, to a range of technical and non\-technical audiences.

* Prior experience in model validation, including the independent review and challenge of quantitative models or AI systems within a financial institution.

**What we offer**


At Citi, you will work in a high\-performing, globally connected team that sits at the intersection of AI innovation and financial risk governance. This is a role with real influence — your assessments and recommendations shape how AI is deployed responsibly across one of the most complex financial organisations in the world.


* A hybrid working arrangement with 3 days in the office and 2 days working remotely, providing flexibility alongside meaningful in\-person collaboration.
* Exposure to the full spectrum of AI sub\-fields — from Generative AI and Agentic AI to computer vision and anomaly detection — at a scale few organisations can offer.
* The opportunity to contribute to strategic, cross\-functional initiatives that influence AI governance standards across global markets and business lines.
* Continuous learning and professional development, with access to cutting\-edge AI and risk management practices in a rapidly evolving field.
* A performance\-driven environment where your analytical contributions are visible, valued, and directly connected to business outcomes.
* Competitive financial wellbeing and benefits, alongside a global organisation with long\-term career pathways across risk, AI, and financial services.

title: Commissioning Project Engineer, Data Center Capacity Delivery Commissioning APJC
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. AWS Infrastructure is responsible for the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we're looking for talented people who want to help. You'll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles to power the world's largest cloud computing infrastructure.  

  

This role offers a structured development path within the Commissioning organization:  

* Comprehensive onboarding and training on AWS commissioning processes and management systems
* Mentorship from DCCD Cx team members
* Exposure to diverse project types across AWS's global data center portfolio including mechanical, electrical, and controls systems
* Clear progression pathway: advance to Business Analyst / Program Coordinator (program management track) or Commissioning Engineer (technical track)

  

In this role, you will provide project management support to the commissioning engineers. You will provide support on both administrative and process tasks including vendor onboarding and procurement coordination and commissioning workflow management. You will be given opportunities to work alongside experienced commissioning professionals and will analyze commissioning workflow data to identify bottlenecks, recommend process improvements to enable smooth execution of data center construction projects across AWS’s infrastructure. The ideal candidate will be detail\-oriented, take ownership of their work, demonstrate passion for process improvement and show eagerness to learn and be curious in a fast\-paced environment.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

The key responsibility of a Project Engineer is to develop a detailed understanding of AWS critical infrastructure. You will learn the fundamentals related to managing a commissioning project within AWS. As part of this process you will work with different team members who will introduce you to the internal project management tools. You will then progress to the on the job phase where you will participate in the on\-site commissioning activities. During the phase of you will support the Lead Commissioning Engineers with managing a project from beginning to end.  

  

* Manage the creation of projects within internal Amazon systems.
* Manage the financial and vendor management related task of the commissioning process.
* Support the Request for Quote process, ensuring all relevant documentation is available for the commissioning vendors to provide a detailed quote.
* Provide administrative support to commissioning engineers in managing commissioning workflows and processes
* Organize and maintain commissioning documentation
* Gather feedback from commissioning engineers and stakeholders to improve workflows and processes by identifying and implementing workflows improvements

  

About the team  

Join the commissioning team, a critical function within AWS Data Center Capacity Delivery that ensures technical excellence and operational readiness across our global data center construction portfolio. Our team provides oversight and coordination of multi\-discipline commissioning activities related to pre\-commissioning, startup, and acceptance testing of Amazon critical infrastructure construction projects.  

  

As part of the Data Center Commissioning Team, you will be part of a highly creative, efficient team tasked with tackling fascinating and challenging problems building and supporting the operations of AWS owned data centers within the APJC region and globally. The AWS Data Center Capacity Delivery Commissioning team (DCCD Cx) understands, evaluates, defines, and manages the expectations of construction and equipment quality in accordance with engineering designs to meet customer requirements and ensure systems perform as designed.  

  

This role offers a unique opportunity to develop expertise in data center commissioning and startup coordination within one of the world's most innovative technology companies. You'll receive mentorship from industry\-leading commissioning professionals, gain exposure to technology leading critical infrastructure systems, and contribute to projects that shape the future of cloud computing infrastructure.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree or above in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering, or Master's degree or above in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering
* Knowledge of Microsoft Office products and applications (Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Visio, and MS Project) at an advanced level
* Experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Knowledge of mechanical and electrical systems
* Experience in designing experiments and statistical analysis of results

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Universal Banker
description:
**Some careers open more doors than others.**


If you’re looking for a career that will unlock new opportunities, join HSBC and experience the possibilities. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

**Business Descriptor**


Within International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB), we serve 41 million customers globally, including 6\.7 million who are international, from retail customers to ultra high net worth individuals and their families. We help our customers to take care of their day\-to\-day finances and to manage, protect and grow their wealth. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world\-class wealth management through best\-in\-class, mobile\-first capabilities and exceptional people. Our key areas of operations include Retail Banking and Wealth Management, Asset Management, Global Private Banking and Insurance.

 **Job Introduction**


The Universal Banker (UB) role within HSBC's International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB) is pivotal in executing a multiyear growth strategy. This strategy is centered on positioning HSBC as a global bank committed to India's long\-term growth story, leveraging its full scale of global capabilities. The business is poised for expansion, with plans to add 20 more branches to its existing fleet of 26 branches. The Universal Banker will play a crucial customer\-facing role, servicing primarily walk\-in customers and managing their requirements to ensure satisfaction. This role is integral to delivering effective branch customer interface functions in the front office and teller areas, aligning with the TCF principles to transition from mere transaction processing to need\-based sales.

**Principal Responsibilities**

* Ensure effective delivery of branch customer interface functions to achieve high levels of customer satisfaction and operational efficiency.
* Implement TCF principles in daily customer interactions, transitioning from transaction processing to need\-based sales.
* Maintain branch hygiene standards by ensuring promotional materials are correctly displayed and the banking hall and ATMs are clean.
* Manage customer complaints and escalations to ensure a positive customer experience.
* Migrate customers to alternate delivery channels in a friendly manner.
* Adhere to operational standards set by the bank, maintaining control over customer deliverables and implementing audit recommendations.
* Attain key performance indicators (KPIs) by acquiring new customers and promoting credit card and general insurance products.
* Meet KPIs for referrals and cross\-selling opportunities.

**Education Qualifications / Certifications and Requirements**

* Graduate degree
* Experience ranging 1 – 2 years

**Other Requirements (Knowledge and Experience)**

* Holistic understanding of branch operations and processes within the bank.
* Sound understanding of the company's customer service requirements.
* Exceptional and updated knowledge of banking products, systems, and processes.
* Ability to establish mutual respect and trust in dealing with others, working effectively as part of a team.
* Demonstrated business focus and customer orientation, providing exemplary service.
* Awareness of AML risk and adherence to regulatory guidelines and internal AML \& Sanction Policy.
* Ability to manage and fulfill customer requirements to their satisfaction, ensuring a positive customer experience consistently.

**Skills**

* **Exceptional Communication Skills:** Ability to convey information clearly and effectively across various channels.
* **Strong Interpersonal Skills:** Capable of building and maintaining positive relationships with colleagues and clients.
* **Highly Organized:** Demonstrates meticulous attention to detail and efficient task management.
* **Collaborative Team Player:** Works well within a team, contributing to collective goals and fostering a supportive environment.
* **Proactive and Efficient:** Acts swiftly and decisively to achieve objectives, ensuring timely completion of tasks.

 **Regulatory Certifications:**

* FEDAI, NISM (Demat), and IRDA certifications are preferred or should be obtained / transferred to HSBC mapping within 3 to 6 months of onboarding

 **Pro\-tip :** Familiarity with AI\-enabled tools is an advantage.

* *Mandatory to successfully complete Anti\-Money Laundering and Sanctions training and post\-course assessment, as required.*

 *As an employee, you are required to perform your duties in a professional capacity exercising independent judgement, discretion and decision\-making authority in planning, organising, directing work, supervising and appraising the work of team members, as applicable; and taking accountability for delivery outcomes. You’ll achieve more at HSBC.

The ideal candidate will bring strong program leadership, data\-driven decision\-making, executive communication and cross\-functional partnership skills to help shift the organization from reactive awareness to proactive, measurable risk reduction.

* Own the Human Risk Management strategy, roadmap and operating model, aligning awareness, behavior\-change and risk\-reduction initiatives with enterprise security priorities.

* Manage annual mandatory security training programs from launch through closure, including enrollment, reminders, exception handling, escalation, dashboard visibility, containment coordination, recognition and audit evidence.
* Define and operationalize human risk metrics, dashboards and reporting to measure program effectiveness, behavior change, risk reduction, completion rates, phishing trends, secure coding compliance and business impact.
* Partner with SOC, Incident Response, Security Architecture, GRC, HR, Legal, Technology and business teams to identify behavioral patterns, threat trends and human\-risk signals, then convert those insights into proactive education, controls and remediation plans.
* Lead HRM governance discussions, leadership meetings and executive updates by presenting progress, risks, decisions, success metrics, program maturity and the measurable impact delivered by the HRM team.
* Evaluate, implement and optimize HRM platforms and capabilities, including requirements definition, vendor assessment, proof\-of\-value planning, behavior\-signal mapping, privacy readiness, success criteria and adoption planning.
* Build and sustain security culture initiatives, including ambassador or champion programs, office engagement, communication toolkits, regional feedback loops, and campaign\-based awareness.
* Use AI, automation and workflow optimization to streamline reporting, content creation, audience segmentation, campaign operations and insight generation while maintaining quality, privacy and governance standards.
* Establish and maintain scalable program governance, including SOPs, RACI models, decision logs, evidence packs, audit\-ready documentation and continuous\-improvement practices.

 **What You'll Bring:**  

* Bachelor's degree in Information Security, Technology, Risk Management, Psychology, Organizational Behavior or a related discipline.
* 5\+ years of experience in cybersecurity, security awareness, human risk management, risk management, behavioral change, learning programs or related disciplines.
* Proven experience leading enterprise\-wide awareness, phishing, training, behavior\-change or risk\-reduction programs in a complex organization.
* Strong program management skills with the ability to manage multiple initiatives, stakeholders, timelines, dependencies and operational risks.
* Experience partnering with security, technology, HR, legal, compliance and business teams to translate risk insights into practical workforce interventions.
* Ability to define success metrics, analyze program data, develop dashboards and communicate measurable business outcomes to leadership.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex security topics for executive, technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Knowledge of cybersecurity concepts, security governance, risk management principles and workforce behavior\-change practices.
* Fluency in English
* Client\-first mentality
* Intense work ethic
* Collaborative spirit and problem\-solving approach

 **Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience implementing, administering or evaluating Human Risk Management, phishing simulation or security awareness platforms.
* Experience with behavioral analytics, risk scoring, user segmentation, security culture measurement or human\-risk reporting.
* Familiarity with frameworks and models such as NIST CSF, ISO 27001, SANS Security Awareness Maturity Model or similar control and maturity frameworks.
* Experience with dashboarding, reporting or data visualization tools such as Power BI, Excel or similar platforms.
* Security or awareness\-related certifications such as SSAP, Security\+ or equivalent are preferred.

  


 :

* Cross\-functional skills development \& custom learning pathways
* Milestone training programs aligned to career progression opportunities
* Internal mobility paths that empower growth via s\-curves, individual contribution and role expansions

 **Perks \& Benefits:**


At ZS, your growth matters. We offer a comprehensive total rewards package that supports your health and well‑being, financial future, time away, and professional development. With robust skills‑building programs, multiple career progression paths, internal mobility, and a deeply collaborative culture, you’ll have the opportunity to do meaningful work, expand your capabilities, and thrive as part of a global community. We are committed to giving our employees a flexible and connected way of working. The magic of ZS culture and innovation thrives in both planned and spontaneous face\-to\-face connections.

At ZS, we honor the visible and invisible elements of our identities, personal experiences, and belief systems—the ones that comprise us as individuals, shape who we are, and make us unique. description:
TomTom's services run around the clock — and the NOC is the team keeping watch. We monitor every service, spot trouble before customers feel it, drive incidents to resolution and keep everyone informed while we do it.  

We're now inviting aspiring team members who want to expand their skills and experience to apply for a lateral opportunity within NOC Operations.  

  

This is a career progression move into the NOC team. You'll get hands\-on exposure to NOC responsibilities, incident management, service operations and technical problem handling. It's designed for people who want to build real expertise and pursue a longer\-term career path in NOC Operations. Following a successful selection process, you'll go through the onboarding and training needed to support your transition into the role.
### **What you'll do**

* Monitor, troubleshoot, document, escalate and continuously improve IT infrastructure and NOC operations to ensure reliable service delivery and rapid incident resolution.
* Monitor TomTom's production services and infrastructure around the clock — working across tools like PagerDuty, Grafana and AlertSite to catch degradations before customers feel them.
* Triage and troubleshoot alerts and incidents as they arrive — establishing impact, forming a first hypothesis and taking the tactical steps that restore service fastest.
* Escalate to the right engineering teams at the right moment — with enough context that they can act immediately, and stay with the incident until it's resolved.
* Own incident communication end to end — keeping engineers, Leadership and Internal/External stakeholders informed while the incident is still unfolding.
* Document what you handle — incident timelines, runbooks and knowledge articles that make the next shift faster than the last.
* Continuously improve NOC operations — tuning noisy alerts, sharpening processes and using automation and AI tools to cut manual effort in reporting, event and knowledge management.

### **What you'll need**


NOC is looking for strong analytical thinkers who enjoy solving problems and thrive in a high\-pressure environment with shifting priorities. You should be able to assess a situation and determine tactical steps forward.  

Core skills (0–2 years)  

  

* A basic understanding of applications, systems and monitoring tools — exposure to PagerDuty, Grafana or AlertSite is a plus, though curiosity matters more to us than the length of your tool list.
* Familiarity with ticketing tools such as ServiceNow or Jira — where you'll log incidents, track progress and leave a clean handover for the next shift; training will be provided.
* Good time management and organizational skills — with the ability to triage a new alert, chase an engineering update and prepare a handover within the same hour.
* Basic knowledge of incident management processes — how incidents are detected, prioritized, escalated and closed, and why restoring service quickly and finding the underlying cause are two different jobs.
* Excellent spoken and written communication skills — explaining a technical situation clearly and concisely to engineers, leadership and customers, often while it's still unfolding.
* The ability to work in rotational shifts (24x7\) — including nights, weekends and public holidays, on a rotation the team makes work together.
* A highly motivated, self\-starting approach — digging into something unfamiliar, asking good questions and coming back with an answer rather than waiting to be told.
* A team\-player mentality and a customer\-focused mindset — every alert traces back to someone depending on a TomTom service, and keeping that in view shapes how you prioritize and communicate.
* Basic awareness of AI tools and automation — and how they can strengthen event, incident and knowledge management, improve reporting and streamline ServiceNow processes and tooling.
### **Nice to have**

* Previous internship or hands\-on experience in IT support or a helpdesk environment.
* Exposure to automation concepts for reporting or incident handling. (edited)



We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: AI Platform Engineer
description:
**Description**  



  

  

  

**Invent the future with us.**  

  

Ampere is a semiconductor design company for a new era, leading the future of computing with an innovative approach to CPU design focused on high\-performance, energy efficient AI compute.  

  

As a pioneer in the new frontier of energy efficient high\-performance computing, Ampere is part of the Softbank Group of companies driving sustainable computing for AI, Cloud, and edge applications.  

  

Join us at Ampere and work alongside a passionate and growing team \- we’d love to have you apply!  

  

**About the role:**  

Ampere is hiring a senior individual contributor to build the engineering foundation for enterprise AI. The role covers platform services, knowledge and retrieval systems, MCP integrations, and agent workflows.


This is a hands\-on engineering role. You will make design decisions, write production code, establish technical standards, and remain accountable for the systems after release. You will work with engineering, data, IT, security, and business teams to deliver AI capabilities that are secure, reliable, and useful.

 **What you’ll achieve:**  

* Build and operate shared services, APIs, automations, and integrations that allow teams to use approved AI models, enterprise data, and business tools.
* Improve reliability, performance, deployment, monitoring, logging, incident response, and operating documentation.
* Set implementation standards and build common components that reduce duplicated work across AI initiatives.
* Develop embedding, indexing, and retrieval methods for technical and enterprise knowledge.
* Improve search quality through hybrid retrieval, metadata filtering, access\-aware retrieval, reranking, query processing, source citations, and evaluation.
* Apply appropriate data structures and algorithms to search, ranking, caching, state management, and performance.
* Build test sets and measurement methods for retrieval accuracy, grounding, latency, cost, and failure handling.
* Design and implement MCP clients, servers, and tool integrations for enterprise systems.
* Define tool interfaces, schemas, authentication, authorization, approval flows, audit records, and lifecycle practices.
* Build and maintain integrations with engineering, knowledge, ticketing, source\-control, data, and business systems.
* Maintain a managed tool catalog with ownership, access controls, versioning, test coverage, monitoring, and retirement practices.
* Build agent workflows that plan tasks, call tools, retain execution state, request approval when needed, and recover from failure.
* Implement scheduling, retries, checkpoints, cancellation, escalation, and human review for long\-running work.
* Set controls for agent permissions, credential scope, tool risk, evidence capture, and auditability.
* Measure task completion, tool outcomes, workflow quality, latency, reliability, and cost.
* Apply enterprise identity and security requirements across AI services, including OAuth2/OIDC, SSO, managed identities, RBAC, secrets management, and least\-privilege access.
* Address prompt injection, data leakage, unsafe tool access, excessive permissions, and poor source provenance.
* Work with security and platform teams to maintain the controls, monitoring, and operating practices required for enterprise AI

 **About you:**  

* M.Tech in Computer Engineering or related field with 3\+ years of experience or B.Tech in Computer Engineering or releated field with 5\+ years of experience
* 3\+ years of experience building production software, platform services, developer tools, data systems, or applied AI products.
* Strong software\-engineering fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, API design, schema design, asynchronous systems, testing, debugging, and performance analysis.
* Strong programming skills in Python and TypeScript, plus experience building and maintaining React applications.
* Experience building APIs, integrations, background jobs, automations, and services that use enterprise authentication and authorization.
* Experience with LLM applications, tool calling, structured outputs, semantic search, retrieval systems, or agent workflows.
* Experience with embeddings, hybrid search, metadata design, ranking, access\-aware retrieval, retrieval evaluation, and vector or search infrastructure.
* Experience with MCP or comparable tool\-integration protocols, including tool contracts, schemas, authentication, authorization, and lifecycle management.
* Experience designing reliable workflows with state management, retries, idempotency, checkpoints, cancellation, and audit trails.
* Working knowledge of Linux, Git, Docker, CI/CD, cloud deployment, monitoring, logging, and production incident response.
* Sound security judgment across identity, access control, secrets, sensitive data, and AI\-specific threats

 **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Rust and Tauri experience, or experience building native desktop applications.
* Azure experience, including Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, Azure Monitor, Application Insights, Key Vault, Microsoft Entra ID, managed identities, and Azure VMs.
* Experience with search and vector platforms such as Azure AI Search, Elasticsearch/OpenSearch, Qdrant, Weaviate, Pinecone, or Chroma.
* Experience with workflow orchestration, event\-driven systems, queues, schedulers, state machines, or durable execution platforms.
* Infrastructure\-as\-code experience with Terraform, Bicep, or similar tools.
* Experience with Redis, caching, rate limiting, telemetry, usage analytics, capacity planning, or cost management.
* Experience with pytest, Vitest, Playwright, contract testing, integration testing, or AI evaluation frameworks.
* Experience in semiconductor, advanced computing, developer platform, or enterprise engineering environments.

 **What we’ll offer:**  

  

At Ampere we believe in taking care of our employees and providing a competitive total rewards package that includes base pay, cash long\-term incentive, and comprehensive benefits.  

  

Benefits highlights include:* Premium medical, dental, vision insurance, parental benefits including creche reimbursement, as well as a retirement plan, so that you can feel secure in your health, financial future and child care during work.
* Generous paid time off policy so that you can embrace a healthy work\-life balance
* Fully catered lunch in our office along with a variety of healthy snacks, energizing coffee or tea, and refreshing drinks to keep you fueled and focused throughout the day.

  

And there is much more than compensation and benefits. At Ampere, we foster an inclusive culture that empowers our employees to do more and grow more. We are excited to share more about our career opportunities with you through the interview process.  

  

Ampere is an inclusive and equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, citizenship, religion, age, veteran and/or military status, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, physical or mental disability, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law.

Project Director \- Data CenterPosition OverviewThe Project Director \- Data Center leads the planning, execution, and delivery of complex data center construction and development projects from inception through completion. This senior leadership role requires extensive experience managing large\-scale, mission\-critical infrastructure projects with responsibility for overall project success, client relationships, and team performance.
  
Experience Requirements15\-20 years of progressive project management experience in construction/development
  
Direct experience delivering 3\-4\+ data center projects as Project Manager, Senior Project Manager, or Project Director
  
Proven track record managing projects with experience in hyperscale, colocation, or enterprise data center environments
  
Key ResponsibilitiesStrategic Project Leadership The Project Director provides executive\-level oversight for all aspects of data center project delivery, establishing project vision, strategy, and success criteria. They lead project teams of 10\-20\+ members including project managers, engineers, coordinators, and technical specialists, ensuring alignment with client objectives and organizational goals.
  
Client Relationship Management This role serves as the primary client interface at the executive level, building and maintaining strategic relationships with C\-suite stakeholders, IT leaders, and facilities executives. The Project Director understands client business drivers, anticipates needs, and provides consultative guidance on design decisions, technology selection, and project approach.
  
Technical Expertise \& Oversight The Project Director demonstrates deep knowledge of data center infrastructure including electrical systems (generators, UPS, switchgear, PDUs), mechanical systems (CRAC/CRAH units, chilled water plants, cooling technologies), fire suppression, security systems, and structured cabling. They provide technical leadership on critical path planning, constructability reviews, commissioning strategies, and operational readiness.
  
Program \& Financial Management Responsibilities include managing project budgets ranging from $50M to $500M\+, forecasting costs, controlling scope, and ensuring financial performance meets targets. The director oversees procurement strategies, negotiates major contracts, manages risk allocation, and makes decisions on value engineering and cost optimization without compromising uptime requirements or operational performance.
  
Risk Management \& Problem Resolution The Project Director identifies, assesses, and mitigates complex technical, schedule, and financial risks inherent to mission\-critical facilities. They lead resolution of major issues, make critical decisions under pressure, and implement recovery plans when challenges arise, maintaining focus on achieving Tier III/IV reliability standards.
  
Quality \& Compliance Assurance This role ensures projects meet stringent quality standards, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices. The director oversees commissioning processes, validates testing protocols, ensures documentation completeness, and confirms readiness for operational handover with guaranteed uptime commitments.
  
Stakeholder Coordination The Project Director orchestrates collaboration among diverse stakeholders including design teams, general contractors, MEP subcontractors, equipment vendors, utility providers, commissioning agents, and client operations teams. They chair executive steering committee meetings and provide regular reporting to senior leadership.
  
  

Required QualificationsEducation Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Architecture, or related technical field required. Advanced degree (MBA, Master's in Engineering) preferred.
  
Technical Certifications Professional certifications such as PMP, CCM, or PE license highly valued. LEED AP, CxA, or data center\-specific certifications (CDCP, CDCS) beneficial.
  
Industry Knowledge Comprehensive understanding of data center design standards (TIA\-942, Uptime Institute Tier Classifications, ASHRAE thermal guidelines), construction methodologies, and critical infrastructure requirements. Current knowledge of emerging technologies including liquid cooling, modular construction, edge computing facilities, and sustainable data center practices.
  
Project Management Expertise Mastery of project controls, scheduling methodologies (CPM, Lean Construction), cost management systems, and contract administration. Experience with major project delivery methods including Design\-Build, CM\-at\-Risk, and IPD.
  
Leadership Competencies Exceptional leadership presence with ability to influence outcomes, drive accountability, and inspire high\-performing teams. Strategic thinking with strong business acumen. Executive communication skills with ability to present confidently to C\-level audiences. Decisive under pressure with sound judgment in complex situations.
  
Business Development Track record supporting pursuit activities, participating in client presentations, and contributing to proposal development. Ability to identify expansion opportunities within existing accounts.
  
  

Additional RequirementsMission\-Critical Mindset Deep appreciation for the critical nature of data center operations where downtime is measured in millions of dollars per minute. Commitment to zero\-defect construction and operational excellence.
  
Preferred ExperienceHyperscale facilities (AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud) or large colocation providers
  
International data center projects
  
Greenfield and brownfield retrofit experience
  
Fast\-track delivery schedules with phased occupancy
  
Integration of renewable energy and sustainability initiatives
  
If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements below. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!

We’re JLL—a leading professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We have operations in over 80 countries and a workforce of over 102,000 individuals around the world who help real estate owners, occupiers and investors achieve their business ambitions. As a global Fortune 500 company, we also have an inherent responsibility to drive sustainability and corporate social responsibility. That’s why we’re committed to our purpose to shape the future of real estate for a better world. Our core values of teamwork, ethics and excellence are also fundamental to everything we do and we’re honored to be recognized with awards for our success by organizations both globally and locally.
  
  

Creating a diverse and inclusive culture where we all feel welcomed, valued and empowered to achieve our full potential is important to who we are today and where we’re headed in the future. And we know that unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives help us think bigger, spark innovation and succeed together.

Build graph ingestion pipelines, semantic data products, vector integrations, LLM grounding layers, APIs, and governed access patterns on Azure while improving performance, reliability, scalability, and cost efficiency.  

Lead the build of Knowledge Graph solutions that transform client data architecture within a large program scope.  

Direct the design, development, and implementation of AI, semantic layer, ontology, taxonomy, schema, graph modeling, and knowledge curation solutions, ensuring all components work together seamlessly.  

Work with project leaders, delivery leads, client stakeholders, architects, data engineers, AI engineers, product teams, and domain SMEs to create standout graph\-powered data and AI offerings.  

Develop strong client relationships, earn trust as a key advisor, and explain the business value of semantic layer, ontology, and knowledge graph solutions.  

Make the business case for the recommended semantic layer solution and contribute meaningfully to sales, pre\-sales, estimation, proposal inputs, and solution shaping activities.  

Provide thought leadership on technology trends, innovation opportunities, limitations, risks, delivery concerns, and practical adoption of knowledge graphs, semantic AI, LLM grounding, RAG, and agentic systems.  

Design, evaluate, and maintain ontologies, schemas, standards, and reusable engineering patterns, while guiding teams on data model quality and implementation methods.  

Lead a team or workstream within a larger program, mentor engineers, review design/code/configuration, and guide adoption of new methodologies, model building techniques, and algorithms.  

Collaborate across business and technical teams to drive end\-to\-end delivery for the assigned scope and demonstrate value to business and technology stakeholders.  

  

Required Qualifications  

Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Mathematics, Data Science, or a related field.  

Minimum 3 years of experience with Knowledge Graph technologies such as RDF, SPARQL, LPG, SHACL, OWL, graph query languages, schema design, ontology management, and KG curation.  

Minimum 3 years of experience in schema design, ontology management, semantic modeling, taxonomy management, metadata management, and knowledge graph curation.  

Minimum 3 years of experience designing and developing Knowledge Graph solutions and graph\-based ML models across functional and technical workstreams.  

Minimum 2 years of experience implementing end\-to\-end data pipelines for AI applications, especially LLM\-enabled or enterprise knowledge applications, with hands\-on design and configuration.  

Minimum 4 years of experience with relational databases, object stores, graph databases such as Stardog, Neo4j, Amazon Neptune or equivalent, and vector databases.  

Minimum 2 years of experience leading a team or workstream within a larger program.  

Experience collaborating with engineering, research, product, domain, client\-facing, and cross\-functional teams across multiple time zones.  

  

Required Skills/ Experience  

Hands\-on experience building Azure\-based knowledge engineering solutions with Azure Data Lake Storage, Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse/Fabric, Azure AI Search, Azure OpenAI, Azure Machine Learning, AKS, Microsoft Purview, Entra ID, APIs, and Azure Monitor.

Strong collaboration, technical leadership, delivery ownership, documentation, and stakeholder communication skills.

title: AI Platform Engineer
description:
We are looking for an experienced AI Platform Engineer to bridge the gap between cutting\-edge generative AI application design and production\-grade cloud infrastructure. In this role, you won't just be "vibe coding" prompts—you will be architecting, securing, and scaling our enterprise AI agent infrastructure. The ideal candidate lives at the intersection of MLOps, DevOps, and Platform Engineering, with deep technical expertise in Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Terraform, Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD. You will own the infrastructure that powers our multi\-agent orchestration systems, ensuring they are robust, reproducible, and seamlessly integrated into our deployment pipelines.

* Security \& IAM Governance: Own the complex IAM structures, Service Accounts, and cryptographic Agent Identities required to secure agent tool\-calling and enterprise data access.
* Observability \& Cost Optimization: Implement logging, monitoring, and tracing loops for agent reasoning, while keeping a sharp eye on token spend and runtime costs. Core Technical Requirements Must\-Haves
* GCP AI Ecosystem: Hands\-on experience with Vertex AI Agent Builder (or Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform components like Agent Studio, Agent Development Kit (ADK), and Agent Engine).
* Advanced Terraform: Deep knowledge of writing reusable, modular Terraform code to manage complex cloud environments, IAM policies, and managed services.
* CI/CD Expertise: Proven track record of configuring complex GitLab pipelines, utilizing runners, environment staging, caching, and automated testing blocks.
* Core GCP Architecture: Solid understanding of baseline GCP infrastructure, including GKE, Cloud Run, VPC/Shared VPC networking, Identity\-Aware Proxy (IAP), and Cloud Storage.
* Scripting \& Orchestration: Strong programming skills in Python (preferred for Agent ADK work) or Go.

title: Sr. Principal Solution Consultant
description:
The driving force behind our success has always been the people of AspenTech. What drives us, is our aspiration, our desire and ambition to keep pushing the envelope, overcoming any hurdle, challenging the status quo to continually find a better way. You will experience these qualities of passion, pride and aspiration in many ways — from a rich set of career development programs to support of community service projects to social events that foster fun and relationship building across our global community.

**The Role**
------------


AspenTech is an AI\-powered software company helping the world’s leading energy, chemical and engineering companies succeed in their digital transformation, making their operations more efficient and reducing impact on the environment. At AspenTech, you will be part of a global market\-leading company with double\-digit growth and a blue\-chip customer base. We offer the opportunity to make an impact, to drive innovation and to be an agent of positive change. Our culture and vision have taken dramatic leaps forward over the past two years and we still have work to do. We need extraordinary individuals to pave the way ahead. We strive to make your story at AspenTech a great one.  

  

As a Sr. Principal Solution Consultant, you will collaborate closely with AspenTech sales teams to lead consultative discovery sessions, craft visionary solutions, and design strategies tailored to customer needs. Your deep understanding of the industries and coupled with AspenTech's broad product portfolio and value\-enablers will drive opportunities that deliver significant business value to our customers and AspenTech.  

In this customer\-facing role, you will leverage your technical domain expertise, industry knowledge, and business acumen to position AspenTech solutions effectively.**Your Impact**
---------------

* Leading and executing the technical qualification of solutions to a business outcome.
* Serving as a discipline/practice subject matter expert with a strong understanding of operational challenges, best practices, and industry trends.
* Learning the complete AspenTech product portfolio to identify and apply products that solve real customer business challenges, including the value of solving those challenges.
* Developing the messaging and materials necessary to position AspenTech solutions in the industry – making adaptations for regional or market differences.
* Partnering closely with Sales Account Managers throughout the sales cycle, from discovery and solution design to executive presentations and deal execution.
* Engaging the senior executive level of customer organisations to paint the vision of how AspenTech can be a partner in their digitalisation journey.
* Developing industry\-specific solutions, aligning technology with measurable business value.
* Providing market input to the Product Management teams to improve solution adoption.
* Identifying and leading sales campaigns to improve AspenTech’s reach, pipeline and awareness.
* Coaching and enabling Sales Account Managers and Solution Consultants on industry\-specific messaging, customer engagement strategies and solution positioning.
* Representing AspenTech at industry conferences, customer forums, webinars and trade events across the region.

**What You'll Need**
--------------------

* 14 \+ years of experience in industrial software, services, solution consulting, presales, technical sales or related customer\-facing technical roles.
* Bachelor’s degree in Chemical Engineering or a related technical discipline (preferred).
* Proficiency in Industrial Data Platforms (Inmation), Historians (IP.21\), and Advanced Process Control (APC) \& Real Time Optimization (RTO) (DMC3, GDOT, Aspen Plus), or equivalent competitor technologies.
* Demonstrated successes in business development.
* Strong ability to bridge technology and business, articulating high\-level technical solutions and their differentiated value.
* Strong drive to convert opportunities into recognised value for customers, with exceptional problem\-solving and analytical skills.
* Proficiency in English.
* Must be authorized to work in India without restriction/sponsorship.

**Nice\-to\-Have**

* Services or solution consulting exposure to industries such as Metals \& Mining, LNG, Specialty Chemicals, Pharmaceuticals, Polymers, Consumer Packaged Goods, Food \& Beverage, Pulp \& Paper, Power Generation, and Water \& Wastewater.
* Breadth across several AspenTech solution areas / well\-rounded across multiple disciplines.
* Knowledge of AI/ML solutions and their application in industry.
* Strong understanding of digital transformation initiatives within asset\-intensive industries.
* Working knowledge of Supply Chain/Production Planning \& Scheduling \- Aspen Plant Scheduler, Aspen Unified Planning, or equivalent competitor technologies.


Regional travel up to 35%.


\#LI\-RK1
